note: Independently re-judged 2026-10-28 after the ba03d7c2c7 ESP cipher change, from rfc/full/rfc5282.txt Section 8: "This document updates [RFC4306] to require that when an authenticated encryption algorithm is selected as the encryption algorithm for any SA (IKE or ESP), an integrity algorithm MUST NOT be selected for that SA." Read all six tagged tests, their fixtures and the producing selectors. The IKE positive requires AUTH_NONE and zero integrity key length, then an actually established AEAD handshake with empty SK_ai and SK_ar; its negative adds only HMAC-SHA256 to the otherwise valid AES-GCM offer and requires refusal. The ESP initiator positive pins both AES-GCM and AUTH_NONE despite a configured hash; its negative adds only the non-NONE integrity transform to that same valid offer. The responder positive drives selectResponderESP with a complete hand-built AES-GCM/ESN proposal, pins the accepted peer proposal number and an answer containing exactly one AES-GCM encryption transform and zero integrity transforms; its negative requires ErrNoProposalChosen and no accepted proposal number for the same offer plus HMAC-SHA256. These independent conforming controls prevent reject-all success, and the malformed offers introduce no unrelated missing transform or bad key length. Both SA kinds and both ESP selection paths are represented, rather than only IKE. The changed matchESP now independently refuses AEAD with non-NONE integrity, checks remote/local integrity equality, resolves any non-NONE ESP integrity and returns the peer proposal; the first guard plus equality both protect this negative input. resolveESPTransforms still builds AUTH_NONE for AEAD. The responder's espProposalMatches accepts absent integrity or an offered NONE alternative for AEAD, and the selected answer omits integrity; accepting a NONE alternative is not selecting a non-NONE algorithm. IKE selection compares against localIKEProposals' AUTH_NONE through acceptIntegrity. Tests exercise AES-GCM, while the shared ID/property-based guards cover the admitted AEAD family by source reading, not per-cipher execution proof. Retain enforced. Existing whole-function revert records demonstrate reachability only, not that each individual guard is necessary; any fresh discriminatory observations belong to the native record repair and are not fabricated by this judgment. No tests were run by this auditor.
